import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long n, k, mod;
    static int[] jc = new int[262155];
    static int[] inv = new int[262155];
    static int[] jc2 = new int[262155];
    static int[] Log = new int[262155];
    static int[][] dp = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[262155][31];
    static List<int[]> tp = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] getcntCache = new int[263];

    static class Pair {
        int n, k;
        Pair(int n, int k) {
            this.n = n; this.k = k;
        }
    }

    public static void RInt(BufferedReader br, int[] v) throws IOException {
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        for(int i = 0; i < v.length; ++i) {
            v[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
    }

    public static long RLong(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        return Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
    }

    static int getcnt(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while(x != 0 && x % 2 == 0) {
            ++cnt;
            x /= 2;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int ksm(int x, long y) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = x;
        while(y > 0) {
            if((y & 1) == 1)
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return (int)ret;
    }

    static int C(int n, int m) {
        return (int)(((long)jc[n] * inv[m] % mod) * inv[n - m] % mod);
    }

    static int dfs(int n, int k) {
        if(n == 0) return 1;
        if(k == 0) return 0;
        if(dp[n][k] != -1) {
            return dp[n][k];
        }
        int di = (1 << Log[n]);
        int ret = 0;
        for(int i = n; i >= di; i -= 2) {
            ret = (int)((ret + ((long)C(n, i) * dfs(n - i, k - 1)) % mod) * k) % mod;
        }
        return dp[n][k] = ret;
    }

    static int bfs(int n, int k) {
        Queue<Pair> que = new LinkedList<>();
        que.offer(new Pair(n, k));
        tp.clear();

        while(!que.isEmpty()) {
            Pair front = que.poll();
            int curN = front.n, curK = front.k;
            tp.add(new int[]{curN, curK});
            if(curN == 0 || curK == 0) continue;
            int di = (1 << Log[curN]);
            for(int i = curN; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                if(jc2[i] + jc2[curN - i] == jc2[curN] && !vis[i][curK - 1]) {
                    vis[i][curK - 1] = true;
                    que.offer(new Pair(i, curK - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for(int idx = tp.size() - 1; idx >=0; --idx) {
            int nVal = tp.get(idx)[0], kVal = tp.get(idx)[1];
            if(nVal == 0) {
                dp[nVal][kVal] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if(kVal == 0) {
                dp[nVal][kVal] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            int di = (1 << Log[nVal]);
            long sum = 0;
            for(int i = nVal; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                if(jc2[i] + jc2[nVal - i] == jc2[nVal]) {
                    sum += ((long)C(nVal, i) * dp[nVal - i][kVal - 1]) % mod * kVal;
                }
            }
            dp[nVal][kVal] = (int)(sum % mod);
        }
        return dp[tp.get(tp.size() - 1)[0]][tp.get(tp.size() - 1)[1]];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Long.parseLong(firstLine[0]);
        k = Long.parseLong(firstLine[1]);
        mod = Long.parseLong(firstLine[2]);

        for(int i = 0; i < 262155; ++i) {

        }
        for(int i = 0; i <= 262150; ++i) {
            jc[i] = (int)((i == 0) ? 1 : ((long)jc[i - 1] * i) % mod);
            Log[i] = (i > 0 ? Log[i >> 1] + 1 : -1);
            jc2[i] = (i > 0 ? jc2[i - 1] + getcnt(i) : 0);
        }
        inv[262150] = (int)ksm(jc[262150], mod - 2);
        for(int i = 262149; i > 0; --i) {
            inv[i] = (int)(((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod);
        }
        inv[0] = inv[1];

        if(n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(ksm(k % mod, n));
        } else {
            int cnt = 0;
            for(int i = 0; i < 62; ++i) {

            }
            long ans = ksm(k % mod, n);
            System.out.println((int)(((ans - bfs((int)n, (int)k)) % mod + mod) % mod));
        }
    }
}
